title: Tenma Saki — Featuring Pompompurin〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Humhumhuuum♪ Puroland was so fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We didn't get to ring Hello Kitty's Bell of Happiness...
But next time, we're gonna ring that bell for sure! And not at a satellite park, but the actual Sanrio Puroland.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanna see Purin again after all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh...
That's right! Rin wanted to see Puroland too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I should go show her the pictures from today!
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey! Rin!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Maybe she went to bed already? Okay, I'll try again tomor—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? What was that bright light just now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wha—?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah! What's going on?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh! Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whaaat?! What are you all doing here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're not quite sure either. Our phones lit up and somehow we ended up here.
Hm? Is someone there?

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: P-Purin?!

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Whaaat? You know me? Yaaay, that makes me so happy!

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line:
But, hmmm...
Somehow I feel like I know all of you too...
I wonder why?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's cause we met today at Puroland! We took a photo together and everything! Check it out!

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Wow, you're right! Teehee, you're pinching your cheeks just like me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We visited the Happy Pompompurin Room too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah. Lots of your friends were there, and the room was very cute.

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Teehee, isn't it? I really like that room too♪

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Um, you probably told me when we took the photo together, but could you tell me all of your names again?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Course! My name's Saki. Great to meet you, Purin!

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Nice to meet you too, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My name is Ichika. It's nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm Honami. I hope we can be great friends.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: *Stare*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
I'm Shiho. Nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Ichika, Honami and Shiho! Nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, by the way, do you know what this place is? The four of us just got here.

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line:
Hmmm, I made a new friend here and she told me it was, um, what was it called again? Um...
Uhhhh...

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Oh! I remember! She said this is a SEKAI formed from a fragment of a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So then, this place is a SEKAI too?

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Probably! She said it came about because of all the people who thought things like “Puroland was so fun!” and “I wanna go back again!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We didn't get to ring Hello Kitty's Bell of Happiness...
But next time, we're gonna ring that bell for sure! And not at a satellite park, but the actual Sanrio Puroland.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanna see Purin again after all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Maybe...
We were brought here because I thought about wanting to see Purin again?

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Huh? You wanted to see me again, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ And now that my wish came true, let's make some memories together!

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Yaaay! Okay okay, wanna go on an adventure?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: An adventure?

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Uh-huh! I was exploring this SEKAI by myself before...

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: But it'd be much more fun together, and we could make lots of memories that way!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, I'd love to! Let's have an adventure, Purin!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But, what exactly does an adventure entail?

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Well, I didn't have anything that made me go, “I wanna do this!”

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: I just sorta look around for a comfy patch of grass to roll around in, or follow the trail of a sweet-smelling snack!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh. In that case, if it's all right with everyone, how about we go find the Bell of Happiness?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This place does look a lot like Puroland, so there's probably a bell here too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And that tree over there looks exactly like the Wisdom Tree.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh but, are you sure you don't mind missing out on the other areas? In such an adorable SEKAI like this?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. We were all sad we didn't get to ring the bell before too.

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: When you ring the Bell of Happiness, you become best buds for life! I wanna ring it with you guys too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, thanks everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then it's off to find the bell we go!

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Look! Look! The flowers growing here are sooo pretty!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, wow. I've never seen this kind before. Maybe they only grow around here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If it's a flower Ichi's never heard of, then that must be why! Ooh ooh! Let's come up with a name for it!

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Wow, that sounds fun! We should name it something yummy!

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line:
Teehee...
We've been walking for a while, so my tummy's getting rumbly!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mine too! Oh! Over there. The fruits on that tree look like apples, don't they?

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line:
They do!
*Sniff*
They're so sweet smelling. Maybe I'll have a little taste.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
You sure that's a good idea?

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line:
*Munch*
Nom nom nom! So tasty!

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
Now that my tummy's full, I'm feeling sleepy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How about we take a break for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line:
Yaaay♪
But there're no good napping spots here by the Wisdom Tree.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, well you could rest on my lap if you'd like.

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Really? Thank yooou!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whaaat?
That looks so comfy! Hona, lemme in on that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We've climbed pretty far up the Wisdom Tree, but still no sight of the bell, huh?

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Hmmm. In Puroland the bell would be right around here, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh! Look everyone!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
There's a bell hanging from the branches!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Does that mean, this is...

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line:
This is it! It's a little different from the one in Puroland, but this shape...
It's definitely the Bell of Happiness!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So if we ring this bell...

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Teehee, we'll all be best friends forever♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yaaay! Let's ring it! All of us!

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Everyone got a grip? Here we go! One, two...

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: We did it, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, we did!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Purin, everybody, thanks so much for ringing the bell with me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll treasure the memories we made today forever!

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Me too, me too!

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Let's be friends forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!
